Karnataka CM to lead all-party delegation to Delhi for farm loan waiver

Karnataka Chief Minister DK Shivakumar announced he will lead an all-party delegation to Delhi to meet with the central government. The purpose of the visit is to request a farm loan waiver and seek assistance for drought-affected areas in the state. The Chief Minister stated that the delegation aims to secure these measures for the benefit of Karnataka's farmers.
